answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Felt fuller alpaca mark felted into the blocking frame, spelled out in full as each alpaca is a measured felt yield plus a felter's signature. An applicant who owns a raven, owes a quartz and outlasted a glacier is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry. One agent spends 31 minutes and is done; the farm spends 24459 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. The record only grows longer, and a mask that turns up twice is caught by its own echo. Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check.
